modal.$description: Scrim behind a modal dialog. The alpha lives IN the token, so a binding pass can never flatten it. 55%: the page stays readable but is clearly out of reach.

panel.$description: Scrim behind a side drawer or a slide-over panel. Lighter than a modal: the page behind stays workable context, not a blocked surface.

menu.$description: Click-catcher behind a menu, a dropdown or an anchored popover. Fully transparent on purpose: it exists to catch the click that closes the menu, never to tint the screen.
